sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 10:69

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 10:69:1
items.html: The GAR in her, they are like three Partzufim, namely KHB, and are hinted at in the Yod-Hey of the general SAG: That is, in the Yod-Hey of SAG there are three Partzufim: AA, and Aba, and Ima — AA is hinted at in the tip of the Yod, Aba in the Yod, and Ima in the Hey. And from AA and Aba of the Partzuf SAG, he does not wish to deal with them, and begins to explain from Ima onward.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 10:69:2
items.html: The first Hey of SAG, she is Bina of Tevuna, which is the third Partzuf of the general SAG, and she has three Heys in her: corresponding to GAR, VAK, Malchut: Meaning, that Aba Ila’ah, who is the second Partzuf of SAG — namely the Yod of the general HaVaYaH — includes Aba and Ima Ila’in, and they are AB of SAG, and this Ima is Ehyeh of Yudin. But the first Hey of SAG is Bina of Tevuna, that is, SAG of SAG, which divides in itself into RTS [Rosh-Toch-Sof], namely: HBD, HGT, NHY. Now the first Hey of this HaVaYaH of SAG has three Heys in it, since it has a filling of Yod like this: Hey-Yod, and the Yod of the filling divides into two Heys by the calculation, since Yod in gematria is two Heys. And her HBD is the simple Hey, and her HGT-NHY are in the two Heys included in the Yod of her filling. And all these three discernments, HBD, HGT, NHY, of Bina of Tevuna, are all her internality, that is, what belongs to her own structure.
